AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 6)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.

Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.

b.

Demands
4.
Awarding Keenan & Associates Insurance the Employee Benefits Insurance Broker and Consulting Services for Health and Ancillary Benefits
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the proposed agreement with Keenan & Associates Insurance to provide Employee Benefits Insurance Broker and Consulting Services for the City's health and ancillary benefits effective July 1, 2019.
Staff Report
5.
City Council Liaison Assignments
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
Staff Report
6.
Adoption on Second Reading of Ordinance O19-736 Amending Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Section 2.08.080 to Allow the City Manager to Waive Limitation on Removal After a Municipal Election
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance O19-736 on second reading amending Section 2.08.080 of the Municipal Code.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
OLD BUSINESS
7.
Infrastructure Management Plan and Adoption of Resolution R19-12 for Budget Appropriation Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R19-12 appropriating $145,000 of unallocated CIP fund balance and authorize staff to direct HR Green to prepare the Infrastructure Management Plan.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
8.
Presentation of the Financial Projection Prepared by the Finance Advisory Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss the Finance Advisory Committee General Fund financial projection, and accordingly provide direction as appropriate.
Staff Report
9.
Discussion for Modifying the Palos Verdes Estates Schedule of Fees and Charges for Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Including an Inflationary Based Adjustment and for Eliminating the Permit Fee for Residents Trimming Street Trees in the Parkways
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider updates to the Schedule of Fees and Charges, and direct the preparation of a Resolution and scheduling of a Public Hearing for the 2019-2020 fiscal year update of the Schedule of Fees and Charges that establishes the fee schedule for various services provided by the City.
Staff Report
10.
Discussion and Consideration of the Policy for Scheduling Items on the City Council Agenda and Other Matters Involving City Council Operating Guidelines
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the item and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
11.
Consider Proposed Termination of Portions of Reserved Rights from City Quitclaim on Panorama Parkland (Located Adjacent to 900 Via Panorama) in Accordance with CEPC Settlement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve proposed termination of certain previously reserved easements, use restrictions, and requirements on the Via Panorama parkland and authorize the Mayor to execute the document for recordation.
Staff Report
12.
Consider Agreement for Interim City Manager Services
Recommendation: If the City Council appoints an Interim City Manager, it is recommended that the Council indicate the name and start date of the interim City Manager to fill in the blanks of the agreement and approve the agreement for interim City Manager services.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
13.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT TO SATURDAY, MAY 11, 2019, AT 9:00 A.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF COMMISSION AND COMMITTEE INTERVIEWS.
